Facts:
- Evil Con Carne is an American animated series, a spin-off of Grim & Evil, and a sister show of The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy.
- Maxwell Atoms created Evil Con Carne.
- The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy is an American animated television series created by Maxwell Atoms for Cartoon Network.
- The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy is the 14th Cartoon Cartoon on Cartoon Network, although it gained that status when it was part of Grim & Evil because the Cartoon Cartoons brand had been temporarily discontinued earlier in June 2003.
- Some sources still consider The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy to be a Cartoon Cartoon series.
- Gregory Hinde wrote music for The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy and Evil Con Carne.
- Gregory Hinde also worked on the final season of The Wild Thornberrys.
